d:
Pura vishv bharat ki or dekh raha hai
Bhartiy sarkon par aapda ki aar men
Niyojit yatna ko paidal chalte hue dekh raha hai
Ki loktantrik dhanche men
Kitni sahaj ho sakti hai logon ki bedakhli
Jise kuchh ghanton me racha ja sakta hai.
Sabse bare loktantr ki sarkon par
Pahli bar chal rahe hain itne pair
